message: Magic Control Pro v2.7: responsive Calculator, Force, Peek and Lock Screen.
notes: Fixes all 11 audited display issues: measured calculator font sizing and scrollable long expressions; bounded Force layout and value text; complete Peek values; separate Lock Screen preview and action touch areas; keypad spacing; wrapping preset names and value statistics. Firmware APIs, NVS schema, OTA partitions and MC Watch protocol are preserved.
